items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So Art—I sat in a couple of times. And he said, “Listen I got another job. You take this one”.

ctx.x: And was it a nightclub, was it a dinner club?

It was a bar you know. They had a little bandstand and Wardell Gray played there. So Art—I sat in a couple of times. And he said, “Listen I got another job. You take this one”. So that’s how I started to work.
How did you meet Art first? By going to the club?
